metadata.name: Plus42
metadata.summary: Advanced scientific programmable calculator based on Free42 extending the iconic HP-42S

content.value: Plus42 is an advanced scientific programmable calculator based on Free42 that significantly expands upon the architecture and capabilities of the iconic HP-42S. Designed for engineers, scientists, and calculator enthusiasts, it provides an authentic Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) workflow alongside enhanced multi-line display features and expanded register handling.

Building directly on Free42's complete HP-42S emulation core, Plus42 incorporates additional mathematical operations, larger stack visualization, and improved program navigation while maintaining full backward compatibility with HP-42S code.

items.value: Full HP-42S compatibility with classic RPN stack execution and keystroke programming
Extended 8-line display showing multiple stack levels and system status simultaneously
Support for dynamic variable names, directories, and extended precision arithmetic
Built-in matrix operations, complex number handling, and numerical integration
Programmable solver and statistical functions modeled after advanced scientific calculators
